selection: Frequency ordered using ECDICT frq, falling back to bnc; lowercase ASCII entries with Chinese definitions are selected. Explicit inflection lemmas and a limited set of translation labels are filtered; this heuristic does not exclude every proper name, foreign-language component, abbreviation or Roman numeral. The 102-entry opening list is hand selected; derived lexemes count separately, not as word families.
qa: Structural checks passed; source definitions are not individually editorially reviewed.
